rationale: Generated packet inflate.py, 4,475,775 B of embedded payload, inside a directory named superseded_preformat_20260724T1340Z. It is a build product of the ddm_e5/e4/ws1 exporter adapter whose generator is committed, so it is rebuildable by definition and carries no authored signal. It escapes the generated-file bucket only because its parent directory is W_joint rather than one of the measured packet-dir names; certifying is more honest than widening the rule to any file called inflate.py, which would excuse a genuinely new receiver an arm authored.
